item.title: Alibaba Cloud Raises Token Plan Quotas by Over 70% at Unchanged Monthly Fees
item.description:
Alibaba Cloud has raised the quotas of its Token Plan personal subscriptions, boosting Lite, Essential and Standard tiers by roughly 74% to 78% with monthly fees unchanged, cutting per-credit cost by over 40%. The Pro tier now offers 200,000 credits at a reduced monthly fee of RMB 312, down about 37.5%, with existing subscribers receiving the new quotas as well.

原文标题：阿里云 Token Plan 额度上调超 70% 月费不变

Why it matters：头部云厂商大幅下调单位 Token 成本，是观察大模型推理价格战与开发者用云成本的重要信号。

item.title: Nadella Envisions 20 Million AI Agents Working Alongside 200,000 Microsoft Employees
item.description:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella floated a hypothetical in which the company's 200,000 employees work alongside 2 million to 20 million AI agents, likening the shift to the 1980s spread of office typists. He said he already runs 100 concurrent CLI agent sessions and that Microsoft built an 'agent development environment' to manage the cognitive load.

原文标题：纳德拉设想微软未来 2000 万智能体与 20 万员工协同

Why it matters：这是大厂 CEO 对智能体规模化协作的公开设想，方向性信号明确，但内容为假设性畅想，缺乏可验证的产品与数据。

item.title: NautilusTrader Open-Source Trading Framework Hits 31K Stars
item.description:
NautilusTrader is a high-performance open-source algorithmic trading framework built on Python and Rust, featuring a modular architecture that lets the same code run in both backtesting and live trading. The project has surpassed 31K GitHub stars, making it one of the more closely watched open-source infrastructures in quantitative trading.

原文标题：NautilusTrader 开源交易框架获 3.1 万星

Why it matters：虽非 AI 核心事件，但作为高星开源量化交易框架，对关注 AI 金融应用与智能体落地的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Nvidia Hosts AI Day in Seoul, Signs Deals with Korean Government, Samsung, LG and Hyundai
item.description:
Nvidia held its AI Day in Seoul, unveiling partnerships with South Korea's MSIT and companies including Samsung, LG Electronics, Hyundai Motor, Kakao Mobility and SK Telecom. The deals span sovereign AI infrastructure, accelerated semiconductor R&D, robotics, autonomous driving and inference optimization for Korean foundation models, but most remain exploratory or demo-stage with no concrete metrics disclosed.

原文标题：英伟达在首尔办 AI Day，韩国政府与三星 LG 现代集体合作

Why it matters：一次活动打包多项合作，反映英伟达以 NVLink Fusion 与软件栈绑定韩国主权 AI 生态的战略动向。

The claim comes from a single newsletter briefing without public confirmation from Apple, and the scope and enforcement details remain unclear.

item.title: IDC: Global Dexterous Hand Shipments to Reach 25,000 Units in 2026, Chinese Vendors Over 85%
item.description:
IDC forecasts global dexterous hand shipments of about 25,000 units in 2026, excluding captive internal supply, with Chinese vendors expected to account for over 85% of the market. The report says competition is shifting from hardware specs like degrees of freedom and grip force toward tactile sensing, fine manipulation and coordination with embodied AI models, while demand remains concentrated in humanoid robot integration, research and data collection, with industrial scale deployment still unproven.

原文标题：IDC：2026 年全球灵巧手出货约 2.5 万台，中国厂商占比超 85%

Why it matters：IDC 首次给出灵巧手出货量化预测与国产份额判断，是观察具身智能硬件供应链格局的关键数据点。

item.title: NVIDIA Helps Korea Scale Physical AI Across Semiconductor and Robotics
item.description:

Samsung Electronics is expanding its collaboration with NVIDIA to accelerate semiconductor materials, process and device engineering via accelerated computing and AI physics, while robotics and autonomous vehicle efforts extend the same stack toward production. The piece is largely a vendor-driven ecosystem narrative without verifiable parameters or quantified results.

item.title: NVIDIA Advances Agentic AI in Korea with OpenShell Secure Runtime
item.description:
NVIDIA is expanding its agentic AI footprint in Korea: Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NemoClaw blueprints and the OpenShell runtime, while Korean AI security firm AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort agent-control platform with OpenShell to combine sandboxed execution and policy-based controls with detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. On the model side, LG AI Research is opening API access to K-EXAONE-2.5, trained with Nemotron datasets. The announcement remains largely vendor ecosystem partnership and platform promotion, without verifiable technical benchmarks.

原文标题：英伟达推 OpenShell 安全运行时 韩国 AI 生态加速智能体落地

Why it matters：反映英伟达智能体安全运行时在韩国产业界的落地动向，但属厂商生态合作 PR，技术增量有限。

item.title: NVIDIA Releases Dynamo Recipes for Korea's Leading Open Models
item.description:
NVIDIA released Dynamo-optimized deployment recipes for four leading Korean open models: SK Telecom's A.X K2, LG AI Research's K-EXAONE 2.0, Upstage's Solar Open 2 and Motif-3. Tuned for B200 GPUs, the recipes claim up to 2x out-of-the-box performance, with Dynamo serving as the open-source distributed inference framework handling routing and communication across multi-node deployments.

原文标题：英伟达发布 Dynamo 部署配方 支持韩国四大开源模型

item.title: Flide Launches Inference Engine for Decision Models, Up to 9.5x Faster Than vLLM
item.description:
Flide is a high-performance exact inference engine for Jev-style decision models, claiming up to 9.5x speedup over vLLM and SGLang via exact state forking while preserving single-question-equivalent outputs. It supports 30+ local decision models, exposes a /v1/systemone API, and installs via pip.

原文标题：Flide 发布决策模型推理引擎 较 vLLM 提速 9.5 倍

Why it matters：对关注推理基础设施与决策模型部署的读者有直接参考价值，但属细分生态工具，影响面有限。

item.title: Claude Opus 5.5 Ports Three.js 3D Scene to Vanilla WebGL
item.description:
Developer Simon Willison used Claude Opus 5.5 in a standard chat session to port a Three.js 3D scene into dependency-free vanilla JavaScript and WebGL, with both versions rendering successfully. It is an anecdotal hands-on demo showing the model can rewrite 3D graphics code across libraries, but offers no quantitative benchmark or reproducible methodology.

原文标题：Claude Opus 5.5 将 Three.js 3D 场景改写为原生 WebGL

item.title: Tuck Verbose AI-Written PR Descriptions Behind a details Tag
item.description:
The author argues that PR descriptions written by Claude Code and Codex, while accurate and comprehensive, read like slop due to information overload and trigger an instinctive refusal to read. He advocates keeping human editorial judgment with a short human-approved intro, and hiding the verbose AI description behind a \u003cdetails\u003e tag to reduce reading burden.

原文标题：用 details 标签折叠 AI 生成的冗长 PR 描述

Why it matters：这是一条关于 AI 编码代理工作流中信息过载问题的实用经验，对日常使用 Claude Code 与 Codex 的开发者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Drought and Data Center Water Use Trigger Tap Water Crisis in Batam, Indonesia
item.description:
Batam, Indonesia, a key Southeast Asian hub for AI data centers, is facing a tap water crisis as prolonged drought and El Niño deplete reservoirs while water-intensive cooling systems at some facilities add pressure, sparking protests. Authorities have ordered operators to build their own desalination plants, and some firms have pledged closed-loop water cooling.

原文标题：干旱叠加数据中心耗水，印尼峇淡暴发自来水危机

Why it matters：揭示 AI 算力扩张与地方水资源之间的现实冲突，是数据中心可持续性议题的典型案例。

item.title: Critique Argues GPUI and egui State Models Won't Scale to Complex Desktop Apps
item.description:
The author argues that the state models of GPUI and egui are dead ends for complex desktop applications: the frameworks cannot determine what changed and who depends on it, forcing the application layer to declare it by hand and sacrificing the API semantics that made them attractive. The post acknowledges both excel in contexts like Zed and bevy debug UIs, but opposes treating them as the default choice for native desktop apps.

原文标题：长文批评 GPUI 与 egui 状态模型难撑复杂桌面应用

Why it matters：对 Rust 原生 GUI 框架架构取舍的深度技术批评，涉及 Discord 重写等真实案例，对关注桌面端 AI 应用技术选型的开发者有参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Study Finds Scientists Mainly Use Claude for Data Analysis and Writing
item.description:
Anthropic published a report based on 207,000 research sessions and a survey of 528 scientists, finding that data analysis (33.7% of research sessions) and writing (32%) dominate scientific use of Claude, while data collection and hypothesis generation lag well behind. Computer science, math and statistics show the highest usage density, and AI/ML researchers—just 1.2% of the global total—account for 15.2% of Claude Code research sessions.

原文标题：Anthropic 研究：科学家主要用 Claude 做数据分析与写作

Why it matters：首份基于大规模真实会话数据的 AI 科研使用画像，揭示 AI 在科研流程中的实际渗透边界。

item.title: 深圳上半年 3D 打印出口增 127.5% 占全国八成六
item.description:
深圳 2026 年上半年 3D 打印设备产量同比增长 58.1%，出口额同比增长 127.5%，占全国同类产品出口总额的 86%，被官方称为全球消费级 3D 打印第一城。拓竹、创想三维、纵维立方、智能派四家深圳企业合计占全球消费级市场约九成出货份额，其中拓竹已在光明区启动年产能超 300 万台的智造总部基地项目。

Why it matters：这是中国消费级 3D 打印产业链集中度与出口数据的权威披露，对关注硬件制造与开源硬件生态的读者有参考价值。

item.title: JIC 将 JSR 出售给三井化学与 DBJ 交易额超 1.8 万亿日元
item.description:
日本产业革新投资机构（JIC）宣布将旗下全球第二大光刻胶制造商 JSR 出售给三井化学与日本政策投资银行，股权估值 1.39 万亿日元，含债务承担后总交易价值超 1.8 万亿日元，预计 2027 财年下半年完成。交易后 JSR 将成为三井化学控股子公司，三井化学的半导体材料产品线随之扩大，而 JSR 的生命科学业务与三井化学的移动业务均被列为待剥离的非核心资产。

Why it matters：半导体光刻胶关键供应商易主，直接牵动全球芯片材料供应链格局，值得算力与产业读者关注。

item.title: DeepMind 经济学家：即便有数百万 AI 智能体，经济增长仍可能停留在 4% 至 5%
item.description:
Google DeepMind AGI 经济学总监 Alex Imas 提出，即便未来出现数百万自主 AI 智能体，经济增速仍可能停留在 4% 至 5%。核心论据是 GDP 衡量的是美元支出而非实物产出，AI 让商品近乎免费后竞争会压低价格，产出暴涨而美元价值增长有限，类似农业自动化后占 GDP 比重从 40% 降至 2% 但产量大增。

Why it matters：来自 DeepMind 经济学负责人的反直觉判断，为 AI 生产力叙事提供了 GDP 度量视角的重要修正。

item.title: 三星、SK 海力士、美光与 SEMI 磋商晶圆厂机器人充电标准化
item.description:
